description: Source code for the Vp8BoolDecoder class used to decode bits from a VP8 stream, including buffer management and bit reading functions.

classes.name: Vp8BoolDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding boolean values and literals from a VP8 bitstream.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with input data buffer.

methods.name: FillDecoder
methods.description: Refills the internal buffer with bits from the input stream.

methods.name: ReadBit
methods.description: Reads a single bit based on a given probability.

methods.name: ReadLiteral
methods.description: Reads multiple bits as a literal value.

methods.name: ReadBool
methods.description: Reads a boolean value with optional probability.

methods.name: ReadLiteralWithSign
methods.description: Reads a literal value with sign.

methods.name: BitOffset
methods.description: Returns the current bit offset in the stream.

methods.name: GetBottom
methods.description: Returns the bottom byte of the current value.

methods.name: OutOfBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been exhausted.
